Comments:
- **Layout (10 points): 8/10** — The overall page structure is very similar: BBC header, Learning English banner, secondary navigation, dark teal unit header, and vertically stacked session cards. However, the generated page uses a shorter unit section and includes a footer that is not visible in the reference, while the reference includes an expanded unit selector.
- **Elements (15 points): 10/15** — Major elements such as the BBC branding, language selector, navigation menus, unit title area, session images, activity labels, and search controls are present. The generated version omits the unit progress bar, tabs, “Close unit selector” control, and some spacing/details from the reference.
- **Content and Text (40 points): 17/40** — The page follows the same general content model, but the specific unit and session content do not match. The reference shows Unit 4, “Grammar, news, vocabulary and pronunciation,” with “Linking words of contrast” and chickens/mosquitoes imagery. The generated page shows Unit 1, “Welcome to our new course,” with non-defining relative clauses and a Jupiter image. Dates and descriptions also differ.
- **Style (15 points): 11/15** — Colors, typography, BBC visual identity, teal section styling, white navigation bars, and image/text session layouts are broadly consistent. Differences in sizing, spacing, image proportions, footer styling, and the unit selector reduce visual fidelity.
- **Overall (20 points): 11/20** — The generated page is recognizably based on the same BBC Learning English template and has a similar visual hierarchy, but the central unit state, content, imagery, and selector area differ substantially from the reference.

**Score: 57/100**
